description:
Create an action an agent can take during a call. type webhook: the agent's arguments go to your endpoint and its answer comes back to the agent; works on phone and web calls. type client: the caller's app or website runs it (registered in the realtime SDK's tools option, or on the agent's mascot in the website widget); never offered on phone calls. Then attach it with tool_ids on update_agent. Test a webhook tool with test_tool.

Requires scope `tools:write`.

wait_for_result.description: Wait for the app's answer (default), or tell the agent it is done at once, for actions such as opening a page.

description.description: What it does and when to use it, e.g. "Look up where an order is. Use it when the caller asks about a delivery."

name.description: What the agent calls it: letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter, e.g. check_order_status. Unique in the account.

parameters.description: What the agent passes, as a JSON Schema object, e.g. {"type":"object","properties":{"order_id":{"type":"string","description":"The order number"}},"required":["order_id"]}. Describe each property: the agent reads the descriptions. At most 30 properties, three levels deep.

headers.description: Headers to send, e.g. [{"name":"Authorization","value":"Bearer ..."}]. Values are write-only. On update, omit a value to keep the stored one. Replaced as a whole.

method.description: Defaults to POST. The arguments are the JSON body, or query parameters for GET and DELETE.

timeout_ms.description: How long the agent waits, default 10000.

url.description: Your HTTPS endpoint. Public, port 443 or 80.

name: create_tool
title: Create a tool
